    • 字段详细资料

      • attachedTime

        @NameInMap(value="AttachedTime")
public String attachedTime

        The time when the disk was attached.

        example:

        2017-12-05T2340:00Z

      • burstingEnabled

        @NameInMap(value="BurstingEnabled")
public Boolean burstingEnabled

        Indicates whether burstable performance is enabled. Valid values:

        • true: Yes.
        • false: No. This parameter is supported only when DiskCategory is set to cloud_auto. For more information, see ESSD AutoPL cloud disks.

      • category

        @NameInMap(value="Category")
public String category

        The disk category. Valid values:

        • cloud_efficiency: Ultra cloud disk.
        • cloud_ssd: Standard SSD cloud disk.
        • cloud_essd: ESSD cloud disk.
        • cloud_auto: Premium performance disk.
        example:

        cloud_auto

      • creationTime

        @NameInMap(value="CreationTime")
public String creationTime

        The time when the cloud disk was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and is displayed in UTC.

        example:

        2024-10-22T02:41:37Z

      • deleteAutoSnapshot

        @NameInMap(value="DeleteAutoSnapshot")
public Boolean deleteAutoSnapshot

        Indicates whether automatic snapshots are deleted along with the cloud disk. Valid values:

        • true: Deletes the snapshots on the cloud disk.
        • false: Retains the snapshots on the cloud disk.
        example:

        true

      • deleteWithInstance

        @NameInMap(value="DeleteWithInstance")
public Boolean deleteWithInstance

        Indicates whether the disk is released when the instance is released. Valid values:

        • true: The disk is released when the instance is released.
        • false: The disk is retained when the instance is released.
        example:

        true

      • description

        @NameInMap(value="Description")
public String description

        The disk description.

        example:

        zd_test

      • device

        @NameInMap(value="Device")
public String device

        The mount point of the disk.

        example:

        /dev/xvda

      • diskChargeType

        @NameInMap(value="DiskChargeType")
public String diskChargeType

        The billing method of the disk.

        Only PostPaid (pay-as-you-go) is supported.

        example:

        PostPaid

      • diskId

        @NameInMap(value="DiskId")
public String diskId

        The disk ID.

        example:

        rcd-wz9f3peueu5npsl****

      • diskName

        @NameInMap(value="DiskName")
public String diskName

        The disk name.

        example:

        fvt-ecs-bcfb3627

      • encrypted

        @NameInMap(value="Encrypted")
public Boolean encrypted

        Indicates whether the cloud disk is encrypted. Valid values:

        • true: Yes.
        • false: No.
        example:

        true

      • expiredTime

        @NameInMap(value="ExpiredTime")
public String expiredTime

        A reserved parameter.

        example:

        none

      • IOPS

        @NameInMap(value="IOPS")
public Long IOPS

        The provisioned read and write IOPS of the ESSD AutoPL cloud disk. Valid values: 0 to min{50,000, 1,000 × capacity - baseline performance}. Baseline performance = min{1,800 + 50 × capacity, 50,000}.

        This parameter is supported only when Category is set to cloud_auto.

        example:

        4000

      • imageId

        @NameInMap(value="ImageId")
public String imageId

        The ID of the image used to create the RDS Custom instance. This parameter has a value only if the cloud disk was created from an image. Otherwise, the value is empty. The value remains unchanged throughout the lifecycle of the cloud disk.

        example:

        m-2zeb24dw6wripjn2****

      • instanceId

        @NameInMap(value="InstanceId")
public String instanceId

        The instance ID.

        example:

        rc-e8w1cn7634kiam****

      • performanceLevel

        @NameInMap(value="PerformanceLevel")
public String performanceLevel

        The performance level of the ESSD cloud disk (not standard SSD). Valid values:

        • PL0: A single disk can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
        • PL1: A single disk can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
        • PL2: A single disk can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
        • PL3: A single disk can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS.
        example:

        PL0

      • portable

        @NameInMap(value="Portable")
public Boolean portable

        Indicates whether the disk is removable.

      • regionId

        @NameInMap(value="RegionId")
public String regionId

        The region ID.

        example:

        cn-hangzhou

      • resourceGroupId

        @NameInMap(value="ResourceGroupId")
public String resourceGroupId

        The ID of the resource group to which the disk belongs.

        example:

        rg-aekzescnje5khnq

      • serialNumber

        @NameInMap(value="SerialNumber")
public String serialNumber

        The serial number of the disk.

        example:

        bp18um4r4f2fve2****

      • size

        @NameInMap(value="Size")
public Long size

        The disk size. Unit: GiB.

        example:

        60

      • sourceSnapshotId

        @NameInMap(value="SourceSnapshotId")
public String sourceSnapshotId

        The ID of the snapshot used to create the cloud disk.

        If no snapshot was specified when the cloud disk was created, the value is empty. The value remains unchanged throughout the lifecycle of the cloud disk.

        example:

        rcds-bp67acfmxazb4p****

      • status

        @NameInMap(value="Status")
public String status

        The disk status. Valid values:

        • In_use: In use.
        • Available: Available.
        • Attaching: Attaching.
        • Detaching: Detaching.
        • Creating: Creating.
        • ReIniting: Initializing.
        example:

        In_use

      • storageClusterId

        @NameInMap(value="StorageClusterId")
public String storageClusterId

        The ID of the dedicated block storage cluster to which the cloud disk belongs. If the cloud disk is in a public cloud block storage cluster, the value is empty.

        example:

        dbsc-cn-zvp2rl601****

      • storageSetId

        @NameInMap(value="StorageSetId")
public String storageSetId

        The storage set ID.

        example:

        ss-i-bp1j4i2jdf3owlhe****

      • tag

        @NameInMap(value="Tag")
public List<DescribeRCDisksResponseBody.DescribeRCDisksResponseBodyDisksTag> tag

        The tags.

      • type

        @NameInMap(value="Type")
public String type

        The disk type. Valid values:

        • system: System cloud disk.
        • data: Data cloud disk.
        example:

        data

      • zoneId

        @NameInMap(value="ZoneId")
public String zoneId

        The zone ID.

        example:

        cn-hangzhou-j
